purpose: Repairs for evidence quotes that fail Codex's MuPDF native-text check; originals kept unchanged in their batches.
rule: Every replacement quote matches MuPDF native text (whitespace-normalised) AND pdftotext text on the same pinned page.
pairing_caveat: When a quote is repaired by several fragments, each fragment is proven present but table pairing (e.g. name<->classification, label<->value) still needs visual confirmation on the pinned page image.
